Emirates NBD Asset Management

From the region, to the region, with ambitions stretching far beyond. Emirates NBD Asset Management is one of the largest and longest established asset managers in the Middle East. Launched in August 2006, our current assets under management (AuM) stand at USD 16 Billion*.

*As at 31 March 2026
